review_comment: Added hasOwnProperty check to prevent prototype pollution attack. This ensures that only enumerable properties directly owned by the object are processed, preventing potential prototype manipulation attacks that could occur with inherited properties.

Modification of built-in Array.prototype can cause unexpected behavior and introduce security risks when used with other code. Prototype pollution is a common concern when modifying built-in objects, as it can lead to unpredictable execution patterns, potential denial of service, or in some edge cases, privilege escalation.
